verdict.rationale: Parsec documents remote access to your own machine from anywhere. It describes the connection path as peer-to-peer, and a user reports playing games from their PC over a 4G network. The only documented fallback path is a high-performance relay that is limited to Teams/Enterprise plans, and the evidence describes no port-forwarding, NAT-traversal or VPN setup for an individual power user. missing for 10: documented port-forward/NAT traversal guidance, a relay path available to consumer users, VPN guidance, in-depth connection-setup docs.

support.subject: As a power user, I can reach my machine away from home, with the relay, VPN, or port-forward path documented

citations.quote: Connect to your gaming rig to take your favorites wherever you go.
All connections traveling through Parsec are peer-to-peer. They never pass through Parsec's infrastructure
The Parsec high-performance relay is also available to Enterprise customers so your team can connect through a relay point in your firewall.
I can even play games from my PC over 4G network.
